ChangeSet.Change: Add CancellationToken (last parameter, named ct, defaulted) to all async members of IReadOnlyRepository, IRepository, IOrganizationRepository, ITransactionRepository, ITransactionService, IDatabaseContext, IServiceBase, IOrganizationServiceBase, IOrganizationTransactionServiceBase, IFluentTransactionBuilder, IOrganizationSettingsProvider, ICacheRepository, ICacheService, IInternalClient, IRemoteServiceInvoker and IAsyncScopedJobService. Call sites compile unchanged; overrides of the base CRUD methods (Create/Update/Delete/GetById, GetAsync/GetByFilterAsync/FindAsync/CountAsync/...) and direct interface implementations must add the parameter.

IOrganizationRepository.GetAsync(id, queryAllOrganizations): queryAllOrganizations no longer has a default value (GetAsync(id) would otherwise be ambiguous). IDatabaseContext.AddCommand now takes Func<CancellationToken, Task>; IFluentTransactionBuilder.Tasks is IList<Func<CancellationToken, Task>>.

Mongo base repositories forward the token to the driver (Find/ToListAsync, CountDocumentsAsync, InsertOne/ReplaceOne, sessions and transactions). FindAsync/GetByFilterAsync now materialize via ToListAsync instead of a synchronous ToList/ToEnumerable.
AsyncScopedJob.ExecuteJobAsync(Type, ScopedJobParameter, CancellationToken) overload: pass CancellationToken.None in the Hangfire job expression and Hangfire injects its shutdown/deletion token.

Framework controllers (AddonField, ModelDefinition, OrganizationSettings, ServiceContract) accept and forward CancellationToken. Post-commit cache invalidation deliberately runs with CancellationToken.None.
Update the Patchhelper to patch list of guid, string or something else.
Update the Patchhelper to be able to patch a list of tuples when configured correctly.
Fix issue allowing to query all organizations when no organization id is set in the request context.
Switch open-telemetry from beta-libraries to stable libraries
Add generic parameter to scoped jobs.
Fixes a bug where Update and Delete using Data.ITransactions do not successfully add the commands to the data transaction in MongoRepositoryBase.
Add Organization settings as optional configuration for each microservice to organization needs.
Add group organization support to settings with groupKey, groupDisplayKey, and groupDisplayName properties for better UI organization and management.
Update OrganizationSettingResult classes to include group information in API responses for frontend organization capabilities.
